rationale.verdict: Walked BscScan (BSC + multichain), docs.pinksale.finance, and github.com/pinkmoonfinance/pinksale-contracts. Catalogued 5 addresses: PINKSALE token, PinkLock proxy + implementation, and 2 deployer EOAs. No official deployments doc, no audits, no governance forum found. Chains Cronos, Avalanche, and Fantom yielded zero addresses from fetched sources; PinkLock proxy is confirmed on both BSC and Polygon at the same address.

evidence.shows: Official PinkSale documentation landing page confirming website is at https://www.pinksale.finance, platform is a decentralized launchpad operating on BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon and other chains, with native $PINKSALE token.

Official PinkSale GitHub repo (org: pinkmoonfinance) containing token template Solidity contracts (StandardToken, LiquidityGeneratorToken, BabyToken, BuybackBabyToken and AntiBot variants). No deployment artifacts or address indexes found. 11 commits, 43 stars, 76 forks.

BSC contract 0x602bA546A7B06e0FC7f58fD27EB6996eCC824689 has name tag 'PinkSale : PinkSale', contract name PinkSaleToken (Solidity v0.7.6, MIT, verified), 100,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 total supply PINKSALE token, deployed by 'PinkMoon: Deployer' (0x3dc0b53da7e6ffb8c85c962b49ddb9e45dc7a79a). No audit submitted. Also present on Etherscan ($19 balance).

BSC contract 0x7ee058420e5937496F5a2096f04caA7721cF70cc has name tag 'PinkSale: PinkLock', is an ERC1967Proxy (UUPS pattern), implementation at 0xB9abf98Cab2c8BD2aDF8282e52BF659aDb0260Fe (upgraded once at block 11385323 on 2021-10-01), ~$57.8M balance, 90,953 transactions, deployed by 0x802651539e977410002803279e2f64c8f0dd5605. No audit submitted. Also present on Polygonscan ($14 balance).

protocol_metadata.about: PinkSale is a multi-chain token launchpad and liquidity-locking service. Users can create presales, fair launches, and Dutch auctions for new tokens, with the platform automatically handling liquidity provision and lock mechanics via smart contracts. The PinkLock contract custodies locked LP tokens and project tokens on behalf of third-party projects, accumulating roughly $57.8M in locked assets on BSC alone. The platform also offers token factory tools (StandardToken, LiquidityGeneratorToken, BabyToken, BuybackBabyToken) and an optional anti-bot system for launch protection.
